title: USPS mail forwarding duration
facts: USPS generally forwards First-Class Mail, USPS Ground Advantage and Priority Mail for 12 months after a permanent Change of Address, subject to postal rules.
Periodicals are generally forwarded for 60 days.
USPS Marketing Mail generally is not forwarded unless the mailer has requested an applicable forwarding service.
Temporary forwarding and premium forwarding services follow different rules.
